description: DESTRUCTIVE: Permanently delete session data matching the given filters. Creates a backup by default before deleting. ALWAYS call drishti_cleanup_preview first. Requires confirm='DELETE' as a safety guard.

backup.description: Create tar.gz backup before deleting (default: true)

confirm.description: Must be exactly 'DELETE' to proceed with deletion

scope.description: Time scope: today, week (last 7d), month (calendar month), or all (default)

since.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD) for custom date range

until.description: End date (YYYY-MM-DD) for custom date range

name: drishti_cleanup_execute
